definitions.explanation: Having an excessively bold or impudent attitude, unfazed by criticism or social pressure. Often implies a negative judgment about someone's lack of sensitivity to others' feelings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{図太|ずぶと}い⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
examples.english: He has nerves of steel. / He's incredibly thick-skinned.

examples.japanese: ⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{平気|へいき}→平気：00095_heiki⟧で⟦いられる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{図太|ずぶと}い⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Being able to stay calm even after all that criticism—you're really thick-skinned.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{図太|ずぶと}く⟦{生|い}きたい→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live a bit more boldly without worrying so much.

notes:
- {図太|ずぶと}い → {図太|ずぶと}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (negative)
- {図太|ずぶと}い → {図太|ずぶと}く (adverbial form)
- {図太|ずぶと}い → {図太|ずぶと}かった (past)

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (nerves):
- {図太|ずぶと}い⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (thick skin, brazen nerves)
- {図太|ずぶと}い⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧ (someone with thick skin)

Can have positive or negative connotations:
- Negative: shameless, impudent, inconsiderate
- Positive: resilient, unfazed, mentally tough

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{厚|あつ}かましい→厚かましい：09161_atsukamashii⟧ - Shameless, impudent (more negative)
- ⟦{図々|ずうずう}しい→図々しい：06535_zuuzuushii⟧ - Brazen, pushy (more negative)
- ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧ - Thick (physical), also 'bold' in expressions like ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧
